ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Combat Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Depth for vanilla combat, without replacing it.
Every feature is off by default and toggled individually in mod settings. Nothing is rewritten that another mod might also want to rewrite: no weapon defs are replaced, no core verbs are swapped, and mechanics are exposed as ordinary stats so apparel, hediffs, genes and other mods can influence them.
Planned systems: melee parry and counter, directional damage and flanking, advanced accuracy, evasion, firing arc, target suppression, ammo, sidearms, and loadouts.
